name: Werewolf
description: Each night, you and your werewolf teammates vote to kill a villager. Your goal is to eliminate all non-werewolves without getting caught.

name: Villager
description: You are a simple villager with no special abilities. Use your wits to find the werewolves through discussion and vote to eliminate them before they kill everyone.

name: Doctor
description:
Each night, choose one player to protect from werewolf attacks. You cannot protect the same player two nights in a row, but you can protect yourself.

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot heal or revive! No matter who you choose to protect, your protection fails; if your target is attacked, they die and you cannot save them.

name: Seer
description:
Each night, choose one player to learn their true role. Use this information to guide the village, but be careful not to reveal yourself to the werewolves.

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot see true roles! The crystal vision reveals a completely false, randomly fabricated role instead of the truth.

name: Sheriff
description:
You are a villager with a gun. Each night, you may choose to shoot one player. Use your limited bullets carefully, as killing an innocent hurts the village!

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot kill anyone! Pulling the trigger consumes a bullet, but it has no effect; your target never dies. (Also, a real Vigilante cannot shoot a Madman).

name: Detective
description:
Starting from the first night, choose a player to investigate. The next night, you will learn who visited that player. Results are always delayed by one night.

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot see real visitors! Even if visitor counts match, all visitor names shown to you are random fabrications.

name: Visitor
description:
Each night, visit another player. If you visit a werewolf or serial killer, or if the player you visit is attacked that night, you die. Use visits strategically to gather information.

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot truly visit anyone! Your visit is purely imaginary; even visiting a lethal house causes no harm because you never left home.

name: Sick Man
description:
You are terminally ill and will die in 3 nights unless the Doctor saves you. Each doctor visit adds 2 extra lives. The Doctor must find you in time!

When Madman (cannot do):
Will not die when time expires! You are not actually sick, only a hypochondriac waiting for a doctor in vain.

name: Father
description:
At the start of the game, two random villagers are secretly assigned as your children. You know who they are, but not their roles. If both children die, you die of grief. Protect them!

When Madman (cannot do):
Will not die of grief! Your bond with your children is an illusion; even if they die, you feel no fatal grief.

name: Instigator
description:
A medieval instigator. Target a player at night to provoke them. In the morning, they will be announced as provoked, and they will start the voting phase with 2 votes against them. You have 2 charges.

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot provoke targets! A charge is consumed, but no penalty votes are added to your target in morning voting.

name: Mute
description: You are a villager who cannot speak during the entire game. You can only communicate through gestures and voting. Use your observations wisely.

name: Intelligence Chief
description:
Every two nights, you receive a piece of intel about players in the game. But beware, not all intel is accurate! Analyze carefully before trusting the information.

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot receive real intel! The two names given to you are chosen at random; both could be innocent villagers or both could be wolves.

name: Journalist
description:
Each night, draw a picture and write a headline for your newspaper. In the morning, your newspaper will be revealed to the entire village!

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot publish truthful news! Even if your headline is printed, it represents the delusions of a madman and holds no factual truth.

name: Necromancer
description:
You have the power to bring one dead player back to life. This ability can only be used once per game, so choose the right moment to resurrect a key ally!

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot resurrect the dead! Your single-use power is consumed but the resurrection spell fails and nobody rises.

name: Chef
description:
You prepare a feast at night and invite 2 players to your table. If both are from the same team, dinner goes smoothly. If they are from different teams, you sense tension at the table.

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot sense table tension accurately! Normally, whether two wolves or two villagers sit together, dinner is peaceful because they share a team. However, as a Madman your intuition is completely misleading (50% fake result); you might feel harmony or tension between two wolves, or sense tension between two innocent villagers and mislead the village.

name: Celebrity
description: You are famous in the village! Each night, a random player learns your identity. You have no special powers, but your fame makes you a known figure, for better or worse.

name: Psychic
description:
You have a magic crystal ball. Each night, you learn a player's class through your magic ball.

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot see true auras! The crystal ball reveals a completely random and misleading team aura (Villager, Wolf, or Neutral).

name: Templar
description:
You have holy water. At night, choose a player and use the holy water. If the target is a Werewolf, they die. If the target is a villager or neutral, the target survives but you are killed by fellow templars for misusing the water. You can only use this ability once per game.

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot use true holy water! The water is plain tap water; neither your target dies nor do you die, having zero effect.

name: Police
description:
Each night, you can detain a player to block their role action for that night. You cannot detain the same player two nights in a row.

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot block roles! Your detention fails and the detained player performs their night action normally.

name: Mayor
description:
You are the elected leader of the village. Once per game at night, you can call an emergency assembly to protect the entire village and declare your mayoralty. After declaring, your vote counts as 2!

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot protect the village and vote does not count as 2! Your seal is counterfeit; no night protection is granted, and your vote counts as only 1.

name: Bodyguard
description:
You put your life on the line. Every night you protect a villager. If your protected target is attacked with lethal force that night, they survive, but you sacrifice your life in their place.

When Madman (cannot do):
Protection is ineffective, cannot sacrifice! If your target is attacked, they die and you survive untouched.

name: Charmer
description: You are neutral. On the first night, choose a player to form an independent Lovers team. If one of you dies, the other survives and fights on for their love. Your team wins when all other opponents are eliminated and at least one of you is alive. Living Survivors may win alongside you. Your team members retain their roles’ normal early victory rules. Lovers cannot attack or kill each other.

name: Madman
description:
You think you have a real role, but you are actually a madman. Your abilities fail or produce random results.

When Madman (cannot do):
Cannot use real powers! If disguised as Doctor you cannot heal, if Vigilante you cannot shoot, if Seer you get lies. You never know you are the Madman until game over!

name: Rabid Werewolf
description: On the first night, instead of killing, you infect your target and convert them into a werewolf. After that, you act as a normal werewolf. Grow your pack!

name: Strong Wolf
description: You recognize the wolves in the pack and they recognize you; the Lone Wolf remains hidden. Each night you attack one player independently of the pack vote. You win with the werewolf team.

name: Lone Wolf
description: You are on the werewolf team and win with the wolves. You do not know the other wolves, and they do not know you. Each night, attack one player independently of the pack vote. You and the other wolves can attack each other. Your attack resolves before the normal wolf attack.

name: Hypnotist Wolf
description: You are on the werewolf team and vote with them each night. You also have a one-time hypnosis power — hypnotize a villager to turn them into a madman. The madman's ability will give random results or not work at all. Hypnosis takes effect at the end of the night.

name: Jester
description: Your goal is to get yourself executed by the village vote. If you succeed, you win immediately and the game ends. Act suspicious, but not too obvious!

name: Survivor
description: You are neutral and win by simply surviving until the end of the game. You have 3 shields that can protect you from death at night. Use them wisely!

name: Serial Killer
description: You work alone and kill one player each night. Your goal is to be the last one standing. You appear as a villager to the Seer, making you hard to detect.

name: Gambler
description: Each night, bet on who will be executed the next day. On nights you gamble, you protect yourself and cannot be killed. Two correct predictions and you escape the village victorious! But one wrong guess brings your creditors, and you die the following night unless saved.

name: Raven
description: Each night choose to either curse a player (marking them) or trigger the curse (killing all marked players). If a cursed player tries to kill you, they die instead. Build your curse list strategically!

name: White Werewolf
description: You appear as a werewolf and vote with them, but you are actually playing solo. If the werewolves win, you lose! Your goal is to be the last one alive, betraying everyone.

name: Mind Flayer
description: A dark intelligence. Each night, you can plant a secret parasite in a player. You win when all other alive players are parasitized. If you skip your turn, you have a 20% chance to generate a new parasite.

name: Wolf Pup
description: The innocent one of the pack. You wake up with other werewolves and vote. If you die, the werewolves become enraged and kill 2 players the next night!

name: Thief
description: Shadow of the night. You are neutral. Each night you can visit someone, kill them, and steal their role to join their team.
